ai_summary: Aarti Surfactants Limited reported robust unaudited standalone financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27, showcasing significant year-over-year growth in revenue and net profit. While an undisclosed exceptional item of Rs. 430.03 Lakhs negatively impacted Q2 profit before tax, the company maintained strong overall performance, receiving a clean limited review report from its auditors and reconstituting key board committees. The non-disclosure of the nature of the exceptional item could be a minor point for further inquiry, despite the otherwise positive report.
